headline: BIGBANG announces surprise digital single for today
sub: New song drops Nov 20 at 2 PM KST, just 3 months after 'BiiiG'
source: Source: BIGBANG official SNS, via Korean media
caption:
BIGBANG is dropping a surprise new digital single today, Nov 20, at 2 PM KST!

The group announced the release on its official SNS at midnight KST, sharing three cryptic teaser photos showing just fingers, toes and the back of a head. The song title hasn't been revealed yet. It comes only about three months after 'BiiiG', the 20th anniversary single G-DRAGON, TAEYANG and DAESUNG released in August ahead of their world tour. According to Korean media, the new song is expected to get its first live performance at the 2026 MAMA AWARDS, where BIGBANG takes the stage on Day 2 (Nov 21) at Kyocera Dome Osaka.

📌 Source: BIGBANG official SNS, via Korean media (My Daily)
